$comment: Cross-reference aliases. Some clauses apply to both entity types but need to point at whichever governance clause is actually generated — the LLC voting article or the corporate board article. Writing <<xr:@approval>> instead of a hard clause id keeps one clause serving both, and lets validate.mjs prove the reference always lands on a clause that exists.

approval.meaning: the clause stating who must approve a decision

capital.meaning: the clause governing what owners contribute and what they receive
